## Action Items (Highest‑Weight Open)

| # | Task | Deadline | Next Action |
|---|------|----------|-------------|
| 1 | Add **periodic consolidation** to the memory architecture and run the extra sweep (rewrite vs append vs consolidation). | **EOD Day 18** (so rebuttal can include full ablation stats) | `Draft: Insert consolidation condition, record F1 gaps, report GPU usage (~30 % lower)` |
| 2 | Re‑implement the **naive‑append baseline via MemGPT’s virtual‑context paging** (external memory). | **EOD Day 18** | `Draft: Scripts for paging, sanity‑check token budget < 1024` |
| 3 | Combine both 1 & 2 into a **single experiment matrix** to fit within the 2400 H100‑hour May quota. | **EOD Day 18** | `Track GPU hours in Issue #214, confirm ≤ 2400 hrs` |
| 4 | Finalise the **ICLR rebuttal** – include rewritten ablation figure and concise response to Reviewer 2. | **EOD Day 19** | `Draft: “The rewrite‑vs‑append study (Fig. X) demonstrates a 9 F1‑point gain ...”, Attach pdf` |

> **Reminder:** Reviewers’ comment demands clear isolation of rewrite benefit. The consolidation step (which mitigates cross‑fact interference) will serve as a principled control; MemGPT paging keeps token budget intact.
